messages:
harper: quick flag: we're seeing discrepancy between SDK batching heuristics and Console quota tiles. tiny thread to align on fix.
dev: observed symptom: TS/python clients batch short requests aggressively which lowers per-token cost but makes per-route accounting noisy in Console. numbers drifted ~4-6% on a few tenants.
nina: is this a telemetry aggregation bug or the batching itself?
dev: batching changes token attribution timing: we tag the batch with the first request's route_id. if the batch mixes routes (rare) the router attributes to the dominant route. that skews quota for thin tenants.
robin: we intentionally allow cross-tenant batching for throughput, but should never mix tenant routes. bug if tenant isolation violated. are we sure tenants are mixed?
dev: yes one repro: short-lived multi-tenant integration where client reuses same connection and parallelism leads to cross-tenant grouping. added guard to batcher to always key by tenant_id+routehint.
harper: propose short-term mitigations: 1) SDK patch to key batching on tenant+route, 2) Console tile to surface batching_influence flag per-day, 3) telemetry event `batch.influence` with sample of 0.1% + full in canary.
nina: Console UX: show small badge "batched attribution" next to per-route token column and a tooltip explaining mismatch. also add link to migrate SDK to 1.2.3 which includes fix.
robin: SDK change implications: PY client has async batcher that runs in event loop; forcing stronger keying may reduce batch merging and slightly increase p99. need to measure perf delta.
dev: agreed. we should A/B: canary orgs get strict keying, measure latency and cost delta vs control.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: batcher-patch v1.2.3 to canary cluster at 2024-06-02T14:30Z. job 9801.
console-bot: note: added feature flag `console.show_batching_impact` default off in canary.
harper: telemetry schema minimal: fields: event, tenant_id, sdk_lang, batching_key, batch_size, attributed_route, tokens. sample 0.5% normal, 5% canary. watch PII.
nina: also add `batch_mixed_routes` boolean so Console can alert if mixing occurred (should be rare).
robin: I'll run perf harness with strict keying and share numbers tomorrow. if p99 regresses >5% revert to softer heuristic.
harper: timeline: telemetry-only this week, SDK patch canary next week, console tile + badge after we confirm regressions <5%. I'll draft RFC and migration note.
dev: PR opened: https://git.redwood/redwood/clients/patches/1145 — includes unit tests and a small stress test. please review.
nina: will add Console mock and tooltip copy to the ticket.
harper: thanks all, tiny rollout but important to keep billing sane. :thumbsup:
